draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click. On your open ticket about Starter vs Pro: API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter -- Tariq will follow up in that thread with the detail.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the natural next step is getting your team working in that project. Want me to help you get your invited teammate set up this week? Teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if more are coming.

Best,
Chidi
